prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity domestic dressing-area mirror photograph.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark chocolate textured waves, defined facial geometry, natural satin skin, and a confident neutral gaze, wearing an opaque pink floral rose dress with a secure flattering neckline and knee-length ruffled hem.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body mirror reflection framed from mid-thigh upward, subject leaning naturally beside a wooden door frame while holding a smartphone; beige porcelain tiles, vanity mirror with warm bulbs, silver bracelet, and no exposed underwear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Neutral indoor ambient light with warm 3000K vanity bulbs and realistic specular highlights on the pink floral textile; subtle digital grain and clear background depth.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 high-fidelity smartphone photograph, iPhone 17 Pro sensor simulation, f/8 structural depth, sharp foreground and background, zero bokeh, natural skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Raw high-fidelity 3:4 photograph with iPhone 17 Pro sensor simulation, neutral indoor ambient lighting, zero bokeh, sharp focus from the foreground subject to the background vanity lights, f/8 aperture, and subtle digital grain. Preserve the approved adult woman's almond eyes, defined Cupid's bow, structured chin, dark chocolate textured waves, natural skin physics, and confident neutral gaze. She wears a high-impact pink floral rose dress in opaque technical micro-textile with realistic ruching, a secure flattering neckline, and a knee-length ruffled hem. Frame her mid-thigh up in a mirror beside a wooden door frame, with beige tiles, warm circular vanity bulbs, silver bracelet, and smartphone. Use warm 3000K light and realistic fabric tension without anatomical or body-part emphasis.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, padded bustier cups, plunging neckline, mini dress, exposed thighs beyond natural framing, underwear visibility, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Keep any text absent and preserve the floral pattern if the reference is retained.
